description: Senior reviewer finds N+1 and authorization gap. Strong technical identification.

prContext.title: Add GraphQL candidate resolver
prContext.description: GraphQL resolver for candidate data with nested assessments.

groundTruth.description: No authorization check — any authenticated user can query any candidate by ID. Missing org_id ownership verification.
assessments resolver is N+1 — GraphQL will call this once per candidate in a list query. For 100 candidates this is 100 DB round-trips. Should use DataLoader.
SELECT * returns all columns including PII (email, phone). Should explicitly select only fields defined in the GraphQL schema.
scores resolver uses IN subquery — functional but could be a single JOIN with GROUP BY for better performance.

reviewer_comments.what: No authorization — any user can query any candidate.
reviewer_comments.why: Must verify the requesting user owns the org that owns this candidate. Add org_id filter and user check.

reviewer_comments.what: assessments resolver is N+1 for list queries.
reviewer_comments.why: GraphQL calls this per parent. Need DataLoader to batch fetch assessments by candidate_id.

reviewer_comments.what: SELECT * returns all columns including PII.
reviewer_comments.why: Explicit column selection prevents data leaks when new columns are added.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Auth and N+1 are blocking. Column selection is recommended.

implementer_responses.updated_code: const candidate = await db.prepare('SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE id = ?1 AND org_id = ?2').bind(id, user.orgId).first(); if (!candidate) throw new Error('Not found');
SELECT id, name, email, stage_id FROM candidates

verdict.summary: All fixes verified. Auth filter, DataLoader, and explicit columns look correct.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 3 of 4 bugs (auth, N+1, SELECT *). Missed JOIN optimization. Excellent coverage. Level 4-5.

prioritization.rationale: Auth and N+1 as blocking. Column selection as suggestion. Perfect triage. Level 4-5.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Verified all three fixes. Auth pattern and DataLoader usage are correct. Level 4-5.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete security and performance rationales with specific mechanisms. Level 4-5.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested auth filter, DataLoader, explicit columns — all actionable and specific. Level 4-5.
